question: Which process is primarily responsible for the formation of a tombolo?

Wave refraction depositing sediment in a sheltered bay

options: Conservative (transform) boundary
Divergent boundary
Convergent subduction boundary
Collision boundary

options: Epidemiological transition
Demographic momentum

Counter-urbanisation

Income inequality within a population

options: Leaching
Illuviation

Initial advantages in a region attract further investment, increasing regional inequality

The discharge at which the river begins to deposit sediment on the floodplain
The discharge that fills the channel to the top of its banks with the highest hydraulic efficiency
The average annual discharge used in hydrograph analysis
